title: Carte de la Traversée
subtitle: Continuer malgré l’incertitude.
imageAlt: Une rivière verticale traverse un paysage incertain et lumineux.
quote: Traverser, c’est avancer sans tout voir, mais sans cesser d’habiter le chemin.

en.title: Card of the Crossing
en.subtitle: Continuing despite uncertainty.
en.quote: To cross is to move forward without seeing everything, while still inhabiting the path.
